captions.detailed: This 3D model is a double-bay cargo strap clip designed to hold rolled straps in place. It features a continuous flat back wall with three perpendicular partition arms extending outwards, creating two open-sided rectangular slots. The outer tips of these arms feature small inward-facing vertical cylindrical retaining lips to prevent the rolled strap from slipping out.
captions.instruction: Please design a parametric cargo strap clip in OpenSCAD. The script should allow the user to define the number of clips in a row, option to mirror the clips back-to-back, the strap width, the rolled strap thickness, and the retention lip overhang.
captions.factory: The design uses a custom 'clip' module constructed from simple 3D primitives. The main body consists of three intersecting 'cube' primitives forming the back wall and two side arms. Two 'cylinder' primitives are translated to the outer tips of the side arms to act as the retention lips. The main script uses a 'for' loop to duplicate and translate the clip module based on the 'clips' variable, with an optional 'mirror' transformation applied if back-to-back clips are selected.
